answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the yarrow index resolves every citation against the ridge checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the horizon audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 2193 identities would post 983 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
